You will serve as the strategic owner for our global Account-Based Experience (ABX) program, responsible for designing and scaling the engine that drives engagement, pipeline, and revenue within our most critical enterprise accounts. This highly visible role requires a strategic thinker with deep expertise in account-based marketing, B2B SaaS / cybersecurity, and data-driven decision-making.

The marketing team is focused on accelerating global pipeline growth in a fast-paced, highly innovative, and collaborative environment. This role is a critical revenue driver, offering significant autonomy and investment to build a best-in-class ABX engine that targets the most complex and valuable enterprise accounts globally.

Strategy & Framework Development
Own the ABX blueprint: Develop, refine, and execute a targeted ABX go-to-market (GTM) strategy focused on driving engagement, pipeline, and revenue within key strategic accounts globally.
Build scalable playbooks: Establish and document repeatable ABX frameworks (e.g., Tier 1 1:1, Tier 2 1:few, and Tier 3 1:many) to allow the program to scale efficiently alongside company growth.
Sales & Field Marketing Alignment
Drive cross-functional alignment: Partner closely with Sales, Customer Success, and Account Management to create in-depth account profiles, unify revenue objectives, and ensure seamless orchestration.
Map complex buying committees: Penetrate enterprise buying committees within target accounts, ensuring multi-threaded engagement across IT, security, compliance, and C-level stakeholders (e.g., CISOs, CIOs).
Localize regional ABX programs: Collaborate with regional Field Marketing teams to scale global ABX frameworks into local markets, adapting campaigns to specific regional dynamics, compliance mandates, and buyer nuances.
Execute vertical-focused motions: Partner with Field Marketing to develop and deploy industry-specific ABX initiatives (e.g., Financial Services, Healthcare, Critical Infrastructure), tailoring cybersecurity messaging to vertical-specific threat landscapes.
Coordinate high-touch field activations: Co-create hyper-targeted regional field events, executive roundtables, and custom account experiences designed to break into net-new accounts and accelerate late-stage pipeline.
Campaign Build/Execution & Content Creation
Execute full-lifecycle campaigns: Launch comprehensive, personalized ABX campaigns tailored to high-value accounts, driving both net-new logo acquisition and post-sale "land-and-expand" (cross-sell/upsell) initiatives.
Orchestrate multi-channel plays: Deploy highly targeted digital, paid media, and multi-channel nurture programs to activate customer-specific campaigns based on accounts' specific pain points.
Collaborate on messaging: Partner with internal creative teams and external agencies to produce hyper-personalized, account-specific messaging, content, and demand generation assets.
Data, Tech & Operational Excellence
Analyze and optimize: Leverage account insights, intent data, and engagement metrics to evaluate campaign effectiveness. Accountable for improving pipeline conversion rates through continuous ABX campaign testing and optimization
Manage the ABX tech stack: Own the implementation and performance tracking of ABX tools and technologies, ensuring tight integration with CRM and broader marketing goals.
Streamline MQL-to-Sales handoffs: Optimize lead-to-account mapping and ensure strong data hygiene within the tech stack to guarantee seamless transitions between marketing and SDR/BDR teams.
Advocacy & Continuous Improvement
Cultivate brand advocates: Develop customer-centric ABX programs aimed at building long-term advocacy, accelerating adoption, and ensuring high renewal rates among tier-1 global accounts.
Stay ahead of industry trends: Continuously monitor evolving ABX methodologies and cybersecurity buyer behaviors to proactively refine strategies for maximum market impact.

s.h: To be successful in this role you have
s.t:
5+ years of progressive experience in Account-Based Marketing (ABM/ABX) or high-growth B2B demand generation, preferably in the SaaS or Cybersecurity sector.
Proven success in driving measurable business outcomes (pipeline, conversion rates) through strategic ABX initiatives.
Expert proficiency in managing and optimizing an ABX technology stack (e.g., 6sense/DemandBase) and integrated CRM (e.g., Salesforce, Marketo).
Exceptional analytical mindset with the ability to interpret intent data, engagement metrics, and translate findings into actionable, revenue-driving strategies.
Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field.

Experience marketing to complex, regulated verticals such as Critical Infrastructure, Financial Services, or Healthcare.
Demonstrated Executive Presence and strong ability to collaborate effectively with C-level stakeholders (internal and external) across Sales and Account Management.
Experience managing or working closely with external creative agencies and media partners.

We're hiring a Lifecycle Marketing Manager to join our Product and Lifecycle Marketing team. In this role, you'll design and optimize lifecycle programs that engage, retain, and grow members across their entire journey with Chime—from top of funnel through long-term retention—with a clear focus on driving growth, revenue, and member lifetime value (LTV).
This is a role for a holistic, business-minded marketer rather than a single-channel specialist.

You'll think in terms of segments, experiments, and outcomes: building targeted campaigns across the channels we own—push, in-app, and out-of-app (email, SMS)—while connecting those touchpoints with the broader, non-owned channels that shape the member experience.

You'll partner closely with cross-functional teams to turn data into segmentation, automation, and personalization strategies that move the business.
This is a role with department-level impact: you'll own diverse projects, exercise significant independent judgment, and influence how members experience Chime across the full lifecycle.
If you're creative, dedicated, and love working in a fast-paced environment alongside passionate colleagues, we want to meet you.
The base salary offered for this role and level of experience will begin at $139,000 and up to $181,000. Full-time employees are also eligible for a bonus, competitive equity package, and benefits. The actual base salary offered may be higher, depending on your location, skills, qualifications, and experience.
In this role, you can expect to
Own full-funnel lifecycle strategy—from top of funnel through activation and long-term retention—building targeted campaigns that drive growth, revenue, and member LTV.
Define segments and translate them into targeted, personalized campaigns across owned channels (push, in-app, and out-of-app), connecting them with the broader non-owned channels that shape the end-to-end member experience.
Generate data-driven hypotheses and run experiments to continuously optimize evergreen lifecycle campaigns and transactional communications, working with analytics to measure impact, socialize findings, and develop next steps toward bigger wins.
Develop and steward channel guidelines and governance, preserving the quality and integrity of our communications ecosystem.
Collaborate and build strong relationships with partners across Product, Product Marketing, Engineering, Analytics, Design, User Research, CRM, and more to develop and deliver on shared strategies for large cross-functional initiatives.
To thrive in this role, you have
4–6+ years of experience in lifecycle, growth, or related marketing, developing end-to-end campaigns from conceptualization to measurement.
A growth-oriented, business-first mindset—you think about revenue, LTV, and the full funnel, not just individual channels, and you can connect owned channels (push, in-app, out-of-app) with the broader member experience.
A proven track record of building segments and managing successful campaigns across multiple channels (email, push, SMS, in-app messaging).
Strong experimentation chops—comfortable with A/B testing and using results to inform what to scale next.
Strong analytical skills with experience in data-driven marketing and performance analysis.
The ability to work cross-functionally and collaborate with various stakeholders, exercising significant independent judgment.
Experience with key marketing platforms (Braze, Looker; AI tools a plus).
A strong self-starter mindset—adaptable and able to think critically to develop creative solutions with limited resources.

Bei TZAMPAS stehen wir vor dem nächsten großen Schritt: Wir haben ein starkes Produkt, aber unsere Markenbotschaft muss noch schärfer, konsistenter und bekannter werden. Markengeschichte & Botschaft schärfen: Du entwickelst unsere Core Message und ein klares Brand Playbook (Tone of Voice, Wording, Design-Leitplanken), damit TZAMPAS auf allen Kanälen - von der Verpackung über Social Media bis zum POS - wie aus einem Guss kommuniziert.

Meet DeepL
DeepL is a global AI product and research company focused on building secure, intelligent solutions to complex business problems. Over 200,000 business customers and millions of individuals across 228 global markets today trust DeepL's Language AI platform for human-like translation, improved writing and real-time voice translation.
Founded in 2017 by CEO Jaroslaw “Jarek” Kutylowski, DeepL now has around 1,000 passionate employees and is supported by world-renowned investors including Benchmark, IVP, and Index Ventures.
Our goal is to become the global leader in trusted, intelligent AI technology, building products that drive better communication, foster connections, and create a meaningful impact. To achieve this, we need talented people like you to join our journey. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI and grow your career in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment, DeepL is your next destination.
What sets us apart
What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected.
When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture.
What we know for sure is this: being part of DeepL means joining a team dedicated to innovation, growth, and well-being. Discover more about life at DeepL on LinkedIn , Instagram , and our Blog .

s.h: Meet the team behind this journey
s.t:
The Product Marketing Team plays a critical role in connecting product, marketing, and revenue. Our role combines strategy, storytelling, and market analysis to drive the growth of our platform. We are looking for a Lead Product Marketing Manager to own the Go-To-Market for one of DeepL’s core product areas.
In this role, you will own and lead the GTM strategy for one of DeepL’s key product areas, shaping how we deliver value to the world's most demanding enterprises. You will act as a strategic thinker who distills market insights and competitive analysis into a clear vision, collaborating closely with product development, sales, and customer success to ensure the successful launch and ongoing promotion of our capabilities within the platform.

Own the end-to-end Product Marketing strategy and execution for capabilities within the DeepL Translator product line , defining how the world understands DeepL’s value and differentiation.
Inform the product roadmap by distilling market, competitive, and customer insights into actionable requirements .
Translate complex AI capabilities and foundational research into clear, outcome-driven messaging that differentiates our core offerings from the rest of the market.
Lead the planning and execution of global product launches , coordinating across Marketing, Product, and Revenue teams to drive awareness and user adoption.
Collaborate with the Sales Enablement team to provide global revenue teams with the training and assets needed to position our products effectively against competitors and measure how consistently they win.
Partner with marketing and Revenue teams on a unified strategy that drives platform awareness, demand creation and long-term user retention
Qualities we look for
6+ years of professional experience in Marketing, Product, or Revenue, with at least 4 years in B2B Product Marketing .
A full-stack PMM who can move seamlessly between high-level strategy, competitive positioning and tactical revenue enablement.
Proven success in driving go-to-market strategies for complex technologies or platform-level products.
A natural storyteller with the ability to translate highly technical concepts into narratives that resonate with enterprise decision-makers.
High level of comfort navigating ambiguity and using data-driven insights to solve complex problems in a fast-moving environment.
Strong cross-functional leadership skills and experience working with product development, research, and sales teams .
AI native, comfortable using AI tooling to scale your own work and a deep curiosity for how language technology is evolving for the enterprise.
Fluency in English and a passion for languages and communication.

Diverse and internationally distributed team : joining our team means becoming part of a large, global community with people of more than 90 nationalities. We're more than just colleagues; we're a group of professionals with a shared mission to connect diverse cultures. Our global presence is growing–we've doubled in size nearly every year, with our employees based in the UK, Germany, the Netherlands, Poland, the US, and Japan, and we continue to expand our network.
Open communication, regular feedback : as a language-focused company, we value the importance of clear, honest communication. We value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and growth mindset makes us better together.
Hybrid work, flexible hours : we offer a hybrid work schedule, with team members coming into the office twice a week. This allows you to engage directly with your team and experience the unique energy of our workspace, while still enjoying the flexibility and comfort of working from home. With flexible working hours and trust in your productivity, we are in sync with your team’s general locations and time zones to foster effective and seamless collaboration.
Virtual Shares - An ownership mindset in every role. We believe everyone should share in our success, and that’s why every employee receives Virtual Shares, linking your contribution directly to DeepL’s growth and rewarding you with a stake in our future.
Regular in-person team events : we bond over vibrant events that are as unique as our team, from local team and business unit gatherings, to new-joiner onboardings, to company-wide events that bring us all together–literally.
Monthly full-day hacking sessions : every month, we have Hack Fridays, where you can spend your time diving into a project you're passionate about and get the opportunity to work with other teams–we value your initiatives, impact, and creativity.
30 days of annual leave : we value your peace of mind. With 30 days off (excluding public holidays) and access to mental health resources, we make sure you're as strong mentally as you are professionally.
Competitive benefits : just as our team spans the globe, so does our benefits package. We've crafted it to reflect the diversity of our team and tailored it to align with your unique location, to ensure you feel supported every step of the way.
If this role and our mission resonate with you, but you're hesitant because you don't check all the boxes, don't let that hold you back. At DeepL, it's all about the value you bring and the growth we can foster together. Go ahead, apply—let's discover your potential together. We can't wait to meet you!

The EMEA Channel Marketing Manager is responsible for driving partner-led demand and pipeline growth across the region by deeply understanding the local channel ecosystem and activating the right partners through targeted programmes, communications, content, and events.
This role sits at the intersection of Marketing, Sales, and the Partner Organisation, working closely with regional sales leadership on shared goals and outcomes. The ideal candidate understands how different partner types go to market, knows how to enable partners to generate demand on our behalf, and brings strong regional execution discipline.
This is a high-impact, hands-on individual contributor role for someone who takes commercial ownership of regional outcomes, thinks strategically, and knows how to turn strategy into action. The role requires frequent travel across EMEA to engage partners, attend industry events, and support field activity.

Channel & Ecosystem Expertise
Develop and maintain deep expertise in the EMEA channel ecosystem, with particular focus on the UK market - one of the most competitive VAR and MSP markets in the region, as well as key markets across Western and Northern Europe.
Understand the business models, customer segments, buying motions, and go-to-market approaches of partner types including:
◦ Value-Added Resellers (VARs)
◦ Systems Integrators
◦ Managed Service Providers (MSPs)
◦ Distributors (including key UK distributors such as Exertis, TD SYNNEX, and Ingram Micro)
◦ AV Integrators and AV Manufacturers
Act as the regional authority on how partners influence, generate, and close demand across EMEA.
Partner Demand Enablement
Ensure partners are equipped with the right content, messaging, and tools to drive demand on our behalf.
Localise and activate global partner campaigns for EMEA relevance and impact.
Develop and deliver partner enablement assets including campaign-in-a-box toolkits, partner-type-specific value propositions, and content aligned to regional customer use cases.
Drive partner adoption of marketing programmes, tracking engagement and optimising based on performance data.
Plan, activate, and optimise regional MDF investments in close collaboration with Sales, with clear accountability for outcomes.
Sales Alignment & Regional Planning
Align channel marketing plans directly to regional sales priorities, focus areas, and growth targets.
Participate in regional sales planning, QBRs, and cadence meetings as the channel marketing lead.
Ensure tight coordination between partner-led activities and direct sales motions to avoid conflict and maximise pipeline contribution.
Partner Communications
Own EMEA partner communications - ensuring clarity, consistency, and regional relevance across all touchpoints.
Develop and manage regional partner newsletters, programme announcements, and campaign communications.
Ensure global updates, product launches, and programme changes are effectively translated into regional context and landed with partners in a timely way.
Events & Field Activation
Own EMEA partner communications - ensuring clarity, consistency, and regional relevance across all touchpoints.
Develop and manage regional partner newsletters, programme announcements, and campaign communications.
Ensure global updates, product launches, and programme changes are effectively translated into regional context and landed with partners in a timely way.
Partner Recruitment & Programme Support
Support regional execution of the partner programme, including enablement, launches, and ongoing engagement.
Collaborate with Partner and Sales teams to identify coverage gaps and recommend marketing strategies to attract the right partners.
Reinforce partner value proposition and programme benefits through consistent, compelling messaging.
Measurement & Optimisation
Track and report on the performance of EMEA channel marketing activities against defined KPIs - including pipeline contribution, MDF ROI, event outcomes, and partner engagement.
Use data and feedback from Sales and partners to continuously refine and improve programmes.
Share EMEA insights and best practices with global marketing teams to inform broader strategy.

8 + years of B2B marketing experience, with substantial and demonstrable experience in channel or partner marketing across EMEA.
Strong understanding of the EMEA partner ecosystem and routes to market, including VARs, MSPs, Systems Integrators, and Distributors.
Proven track record of working closely with field sales teams on shared pipeline and revenue goals.
Experience planning, executing, and measuring regional partner events and field marketing programmes.
Hands-on experience managing or influencing MDF budgets and demonstrating return on investment.
Proficiency with CRM and marketing automation platforms (e.g. Salesforce, HubSpot, Marketo, or equivalent).
Strong analytical capability - comfortable working with campaign and pipeline data to draw insights and make recommendations.
Excellent communication and influencing skills - able to engage credibly with partners, sales leadership, and senior stakeholders.
Highly organised, execution-focused, and comfortable operating at pace in a matrixed environment.

Experience in the networking, hardware, AV, or broader technology sector.
Additional European language skills.

About Ramp
Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.
The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.
We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.
The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.
If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

Ramp is building new products that can reshape how finance teams operate. These products begin before the market playbook is obvious: the customer problem is still being sharpened, the product is evolving quickly, and the path from early signal to durable growth must be built.
We are hiring a Product Marketing Manager, New Products to lead that work. You will be embedded with Product and Engineering from the earliest stages, using customer and market insight to help choose the audience, shape the product, define the story, and build the commercialization and adoption motion.
This is not a launch-calendar or asset-production role. You will own the full business read for the product: customer problem, ICP, positioning, product readiness, launch, pipeline, activation, adoption, retention, proof, and the next product or GTM intervention.

Shape product strategy early. Bring customer, market, and competitive evidence into product decisions before the roadmap is fixed. Help the team identify the wedge, target segment, table stakes, differentiators, and highest-leverage problems to solve.
Find product-market clarity. Define the ICP, buyer, user, jobs to be done, workflow, alternatives, and reasons customers will switch or expand.
Own the product narrative. Build the canonical positioning, messaging, claims, proof, and competitive story. Translate technical and operational complexity into a clear customer value proposition without flattening how the product works.
Design the zero-to-one GTM. Determine how the product should enter the market, including audience, channel, pricing and packaging inputs, sales motion, self-serve motion, launch sequence, and adoption plan.
Lead launches end to end. Coordinate Product, Engineering, Sales, Growth, Creative, Communications, Support, and other partners around one launch strategy, readiness bar, and set of measurable outcomes.
Build commercialization, not just awareness. Create the programs, enablement, proof, and feedback loops that turn interest into qualified pipeline, activation, retained usage, expansion, and revenue.
Work deeply with Product and Engineering. Understand the product's architecture, data, constraints, and trust model well enough to influence tradeoffs and explain it credibly to both technical and business audiences.
Create the customer learning system. Develop direct relationships with buyers and users, run structured discovery, capture objections and product gaps, and turn what you learn into product and GTM decisions.
Own the business scorecard. Define leading and lagging indicators, build a clear operating read, diagnose what is moving or stuck, and recommend the next intervention.
Build proof and competitive intelligence. Develop customer evidence, use cases, benchmarks, and a current view of the market that improve both product decisions and GTM execution.
Use AI as an operating advantage. Apply AI to research, synthesis, analysis, content development, and repeatable workflows—and help the team raise its standard for speed and quality.
Create the new-products playbook. Build a repeatable method for taking an emerging product from customer signal to product-market clarity, launch, commercialization, and scaled growth.
What you'll need
6+ years of experience in B2B software product marketing, product management, growth, strategy, or another product-led GTM function, including significant ownership of a product or business outcome.
Demonstrated zero-to-one experience with a new product, category, platform, or business line—from early customer discovery through launch and adoption.
A record of influencing product strategy using customer, market, competitive, and performance evidence.
Strong customer instincts. You can run discovery, identify the real workflow and buying problem, and separate a loud request from a durable market signal.
Technical and operational fluency. You can learn a complex product, work credibly with Product and Engineering, and explain how it works to different audiences.
Exceptional written and verbal communication. You can produce a sharp product narrative, an executive recommendation, a launch plan, and a sales story that survives contact with customers.
Strong data literacy. You can define and interpret activation, adoption, retention, pipeline, conversion, revenue, and product-usage metrics and turn the findings into a decision.
Proven ability to lead senior partners across Product, Engineering, Sales, Growth, Creative, and Marketing without relying on formal authority.
High agency and comfort with ambiguity. You build the first version, test it with customers, make tradeoffs, and improve it quickly.
Fluency with AI tools as part of your everyday research, analysis, writing, and operating workflows.

Experience in fintech, payments, accounts receivable, accounting, developer tools, data infrastructure, AI, or another technical and workflow-heavy category.
Experience taking a product from incubation through product-market fit and scaled commercialization.
Experience with both product-led and sales-led growth motions.
Experience contributing to pricing and packaging decisions.
Experience as an early or founding PMM, product manager, founder, or operator in a fast-moving product area.

At Sierra, we’re building a platform to enable every company in the world to build better, more human customer experiences with AI. We partner with industry leaders such as SoftBank, Uber, Rivian, CLEAR, and Sutter Health. We are primarily an in-person company based in San Francisco, with growing offices across North America, Europe, and Asia.
We are guided by a set of values that are at the core of our actions and define our culture: Trust, Customer Obsession, Craftsmanship, Intensity, and Family. These values are the foundation of our work, and we are committed to upholding them in everything we do.
Our co-founders are Bret Taylor and Clay Bavor . Bret currently serves as Board Chair of OpenAI. Previously, he was co-CEO of Salesforce (which had acquired the company he founded, Quip) and CTO of Facebook. Bret was also one of Google's earliest product managers and co-creator of Google Maps.

Before founding Sierra, Clay spent 18 years at Google, where he most recently led Google Labs. Earlier, he started and led Google’s AR/VR effort, Project Starline, and Google Lens. Before that, Clay led the product and design teams for Google Workspace.

Sierra is going deep on industry-first go-to-market, and we're expanding our Solutions Product Marketing team to help drive it. This role sits alongside our core product marketing team but has a distinct focus: taking what we build and making it land with specific industries and personas.

You'll own translating product capability into industry-relevant messaging, sales enablement, content, events, and demos — and you'll help build the operational backbone that lets this team scale across verticals. You'll be a direct partner in building this out, and in making it clear that no playbook exists yet — not just executing an existing one.

Industry & persona messaging. Translate product capabilities into messaging and positioning tailored to specific industries and buyer personas. Such as web copy, event sessions, sales narratives, and campaign messaging that speaks the language of the vertical and/or buyer.
Sales enablement & content. Build and maintain the enablement playbooks and assets our GTM teams need to sell into industry — slide decks, one-pagers, landing pages, industry playbooks, and more.
Launches products to industries. When a new product ships, own how it gets packaged and adapted for the industries and personas we serve, including the story, any assets, and sales enablement — all alongside and in partnership with our core PMM team.
Operational backbone. You'll help stand up processes, templates, and systems that let us work consistently across multiple industries and personas without duplicating effort each time.
Range across altitudes. You're able to flex across channels and activations as needed, while also going deep in one area — whether that's a specific industry vertical or persona, or our industry demo strategy, for example. You're comfortable operating at both the generalist and specialist altitudes.

5+ years of B2B product marketing experience. Exposure to vertical or persona-based marketing is a bonus, but not necessary.
Strong operational instincts — you naturally think in process, systems, and repeatable frameworks, and you're comfortable building structure where none exists yet.
Expertise in developing positioning and messaging, and translating it into sales-facing and customer-facing assets across different audiences and industries.
You’re comfortable using tools like ChatGPT and Claude to work smarter and help automate where it makes sense to.
Experience contributing to product launches, including translating core launch messaging into content for specific industries or personas, building out assets and whatever else is needed in support of the GTM motion.
Experience in building presentations using Google Slides.
Comfort operating in an early-stage, still-being-defined team, and enthusiasm for helping shape how the team works.
Sample Projects
Take a newly launched product and build the industry go-to-market package for a specific vertical: messaging, sales assets, enablement, and demo.
Build an enablement plan and content for sales across industries.

Hay Day is one of Supercell’s most iconic games, delighting tens of millions of players worldwide with its cozy, social farming experience. We are looking for a Product Marketing Manager to own Go-To-Market (GTM) strategy and execution – turning every update, feature drop, and seasonal moment into a campaign our players and community can’t stop talking about.
Sitting directly within the Hay Day game team, you will bridge product development, live ops, creative production, and community to turn product updates into major commercial and player-engagement wins.
What You'll Be Doing
Drive End-to-End GTM Strategy: Partner directly with product leads and game designers from early feature concepts to define positioning, formulate clear pre-launch hypotheses, and deliver high-impact marketing campaigns for all live updates, seasonal beats, and feature drops.
Lead Creative Campaign Delivery: Direct internal art directors, video producers, and external agencies to produce compelling trailers, visual assets, and marketing collateral that land with Hay Day’s core audience.
Explore Growth Channels with UA: Partner closely with UA and Performance Marketing teams to test and scale performance-driven channels including Connected TV (CTV), influencer integrations, creator platforms, and podcasts and more to expand game reach during major moments.
In-Game & Channel Execution: Operationalize player communications across in-game pop-ups, newsfeed beats, push notifications, App Store Optimization (ASO), and Web Shop / D2C channels.
Amplify via Community & Creators: Collaborate with Community Managers and content creators to design shareable launch beats that drive organic reach and creator content.
Measure & Iterate: Partner with analytics to validate campaign hypotheses, track launch performance, feature adoption, and player sentiment—using post-launch data to continuously sharpen future GTM playbooks.
What You Have
5+ years of Product Marketing experience in mobile gaming or live-service consumer products (casual, simulation, or puzzle experience is a big plus).
Proven GTM execution track record: Demonstrated experience taking live features and product updates from early concept to full public launch.
Sharp creative instincts: Strong aesthetic eye with the ability to give clear, actionable feedback on trailer cuts, visual assets, and player copy.
Performance channel & UA literacy: Solid understanding of performance marketing mechanics and experience evaluating multi-channel campaigns (UA, CTV, creator partnerships, podcasts).
Data & Hypothesis-Driven Mindset: Experience framing clear GTM hypotheses, defining success metrics pre-launch, and using post-campaign analytics to back up strategic decisions.
Cross-functional leadership: Exceptional project management skills with the ability to align developers, artists, and marketers without formal authority.
Collaborative mindset: Naturally builds trust, communicates openly, and thrives in cross-functional teams. Partner with analytics and support the insights team.
Where You'll Be
You are based in or willing to relocate to Helsinki, Finland. Alternatively, located in London with a willingness to travel.

About Supercell
Supercell is a games company from Helsinki, Finland, with offices also in San Francisco, Seoul, Shanghai, and London. You might know us as the makers of Hay Day, Clash of Clans, Boom Beach, Clash Royale, and Brawl Stars . Our mission is to create great games that as many people as possible play for years and that are remembered forever.
So, how do we make great games? By putting together the best teams and giving them the freedom and independence to succeed. And by taking risks, failing, sharing learnings , and killing lots of projects.
Hey, You Might Love It Here!
Independent cells and trust are at the core of our culture . But it takes more than that to make great games. We take good care of our people, providing them with the compensation, work environment, and resources they need to succeed while having fun along the way.
You Are Not Your Job Title ™
Here, you won’t need to focus on chasing titles or climbing ladders. Internally, our job titles don’t include prefixes like Senior, Junior, Principal, or Director. Recognition isn’t tied to your title, as it doesn't define the impact you can have around here.

Luring you in with glitter, glamour, and gems isn't what we're about. We want you to enjoy your time here fully, so we structure our compensation and benefits with that in mind. It starts with perceiving you as a human being, not a resource.
Relocation? Yes!
No matter where you’re moving from, our dedicated mobility team and partners will support you throughout your move. We’ll ensure the process is as smooth as possible for you and anyone joining you – whether they’re family members of the human or animal kind!
Not Sure if You Should Apply?
Many candidates with great skills and experience second-guess themselves. The bar is high, but if this role excites you, apply! We’re here to help you succeed. Also, we're happy to learn about any specific accommodations you may need to fully engage in our recruitment process.
Wishing you all the best,
The Supercell Recruitment team

About Anthropic
Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

There are close to a billion knowledge workers in the world, and only a small fraction of them have discovered what it feels like to work alongside AI that actually raises their game. Most people who could benefit from an AI collaborator haven't tried one yet, or tried once and didn't see what was possible. Closing that gap isn't a copywriting problem — it's a storytelling and enablement problem at a scale few companies have ever had to solve. That's what this role owns.
We're looking for a Senior Product Marketing Manager to own the foundational positioning and story for Claude's core knowledge-work products — Chat, Cowork, and the broader non-coding suite.

Everything that helps a knowledge worker understand what's possible, and a buyer decide with confidence, runs through your work: the website, the pitch decks, the battlecards, the persona narratives.

You're not just making the case that people should adopt AI — you're equipping the people who decide to buy it and showing the people who use it, at the scale of millions, exactly how to put it to work.
This is an individual-contributor role built for someone who wants to do deep, durable craft work on products with enormous, established usage. You'll write the positioning doc, build the battlecards, and ship the persona work yourself, and you'll use Claude and AI-native workflows to keep those foundations self-updating and trusted by every team that depends on them.
If you've owned the full product marketing stack for a large, widely-used, fast-evolving product, have building instincts for turning your own PMM workflows into systems rather than one-off documents, and want your writing to be the reason millions of people and the buyers who equip them finally understand what an AI collaborator can do, this role is for you.

Define the story that gets millions of people to change how they work. Own and evolve the positioning and messaging house for Chat, Cowork, and Claude's core knowledge-work products, so every deck, campaign, and piece of content makes the same compelling case for what's possible.
Give sellers the conviction to close. Build and maintain the sales enablement assets — pitch decks, battlecards, objection handling — that turn a good product into deals won, arming GTM to sell with confidence rather than guesswork.
Equip buyers to make the call with confidence. Own the proof points, comparisons, and narratives that help economic buyers and champions justify the purchase and adoption decision internally, not just the end users who'll use the product day to day.
Make sure the message lands with the right person, in their language. Develop ICP and persona frameworks that translate a broad, varied base of knowledge workers and buyers into insights sharp enough to drive messaging and campaigns that actually resonate.
Make our inspiring story come to life. Own the website and product page messaging that's often someone's very first encounter with what Claude can do for their work — the moment that decides whether they lean in or bounce.
Turn scattered wins into a playbook others can run. Build libraries of top use cases by product and by function or persona, so the best examples of AI-augmented work aren't one-off stories, they're patterns anyone can copy.
Keep every team telling the same story, well. Partner closely with GTM, Marketing, and Partners so they're never working from stale or inconsistent materials.
"Claudify" our own foundations. Build AI-native systems, using Claude and beyond-chat workflows like Skills and automations, that keep positioning, messaging, personas, and enablement current and instantly trustworthy — proof, in how you work, of the same transformation you're asking millions of others to make.
Contribute to how we present plans, pricing, and analyst relations materials for the core knowledge-work portfolio as they intersect with your positioning and messaging work

Have proven experience owning positioning and messaging for an established software product used broadly across personas and use cases
Have strong writing and storytelling skills, with the ability to adapt tone and complexity across formats — pitch decks, web copy, battlecards, persona docs
Have experience building ICP and persona frameworks and translating research into messaging that scales across websites, collateral, campaigns, and content
Have experience building sales enablement assets and working directly with sales teams on objection handling and win/loss dynamics
Are comfortable operating autonomously as an IC, writing and shipping assets directly rather than through a team
Demonstrate systems thinking, and the ability to move fast and with conviction in an always-evolving environment
Are well-versed in using AI — namely Claude — to inform and automate product marketing workflows, and have built foundational systems that inform, update, and share PMM foundations with the stakeholders who depend on them
Have experience marketing AI or productivity software to a broad, cross-functional buyer base

Experience with analyst relations processes and reports (e.g., Gartner, Forrester)
Familiarity with plans and pricing presentation and packaging communication
Experience as a Senior PMM or PMM Lead at a productivity, collaboration, or knowledge-work software company with ownership of core-product positioning

Since we opened our doors in 2009, the world of commerce has evolved immensely, and so has Square. After enabling anyone to take payments and never miss a sale, we saw sellers stymied by disparate, outmoded products and tools that wouldn’t work together.
So we expanded into software and started building integrated, omnichannel solutions – to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality, book appointments, engage loyal buyers, and hire and pay staff.

Across it all, we’ve embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place.

Afterpay furthers our goal to provide omnichannel tools that unlock meaningful value and growth, enabling sellers to capture the next generation shopper, increase order sizes, and compete at a larger scale.
Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. As our sellers grow, so do our solutions. There is a massive opportunity in front of us. We’re building a significant, meaningful, and lasting business, and we are helping sellers worldwide do the same.

Deliver a new plan for marketing in Japan and set priorities for the team accordingly.
Execute a number of campaigns and projects, both digital and in-person.
Lead a small team, including rigorous performance management against company priorities and culture.
Partner closely with other disciplines such as finance, sales and partnerships. You’ll ensure these groups are rowing in the same direction against a cohesive set of priorities.
Clearly communicate marketing’s contribution to the business, particularly sales pipeline health.
Represent your work in front of executive leadership.
Define, track and adhere to marketing KPIs, budgets and ROI.
Ensure Japan marketing is innovative and that the team stays abreast of the latest marketing technologies to scale impact, leveraging AI in particular to achieve this.
You Have
10+ years of related experience.
2+ years in marketing leadership, with people management experience.
Proven experience leading with significant budgets and driving results in complex B2B environments
A strong analytical mindset with a deep understanding of marketing measurement and lead generation.
Tangible experience leveraging AI to drive outsized impact.
Fluency in both Japanese and English.

Value-Based Strategy & Execution: Develop and execute comprehensive, AI-driven paid search strategies across Google Ads and Bing Ads. Lead the transition to and optimization of Value-Based Bidding (VBB) models to prioritize high-value pipeline and revenue over raw lead volume.
AI Integration & Innovation: Proactively leverage AI and machine learning capabilities within search platforms (e.g., Smart Bidding, Broad Match + Smart Bidding loops, AI-powered ad assets and campaign types) to scale performance, uncover hidden demand, and push our strategy past the industry curve.
Rigorous Experimentation: Design, execute, and analyze structured A/B and multivariate tests (bidding, copy, landing pages). Champion a scientific approach, ensuring all test outcomes are measured for statistical significance before scaling.
Holistic In-Market Reporting: Maintain a unified, real-time view of all in-market campaigns. Deliver clear, executive-ready reporting that tracks performance across the entire funnel from click to closed-won revenue ensuring complete transparency of our search footprint.
Martech & Data Integration: Collaborate closely with Marketing Operations and Digital Analytics teams to ensure seamless integration with CRM platforms (Salesforce) and marketing automation (Marketo). Ensure accurate offline conversion tracking (OCT) to feed VBB algorithms high-quality feedback loops.
Audience & Competitive Intelligence: Conduct advanced keyword research, competitive benchmarking, and first/third-party audience segmentation to identify high-intent targeting opportunities.
Process Automation: Identify opportunities for workflow automation, scripting, and process improvement to increase operational efficiency and scale our search program.
Account Hygiene & Automation: Actively audit account architecture to eliminate query bleeding and campaign cannibalization. Identify opportunities for workflow automation, scripting, and process improvement to scale our search program cleanly.

Education: BA or BS in Marketing, Business, Economics, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related analytical field.
Experience: 3–5 years of hands-on experience managing enterprise-level, full-funnel paid search campaigns, media planning, and advanced measurement.
Analytical Rigor: Exceptional analytical skills with a proven track record of using statistical significance models to validate test results and drive data-backed decisions.
VBB Expertise: Strong experience implementing and optimizing Value-Based Bidding (VBB) and offline conversion feedback loops (connecting CRM data back to ad platforms).
AI Literacy: Practical experience leveraging AI-driven search features, automated bidding algorithms, and predictive analytics tools to scale and optimize campaigns.
Martech Proficiency: Deep expertise in Google Ads, Bing Ads, Salesforce (CRM), Marketo/Eloqua (Marketing Automation), and advanced web analytics platforms (Google Analytics, GTM, or equivalent).
Project Management & Communication: Strong project management skills with the ability to translate complex, multi-layered data points into clear, concise, and actionable insights for cross-functional stakeholders.
B2B Context: Prior experience in B2B SaaS marketing is highly preferred.

ServiceNow is transforming how enterprises orchestrate their business. Partners are central to this mission—they activate demand, deliver solutions, and extend our platform. This is a strategic role reporting directly to the Director of APAC Partner Marketing. You'll work with C&I partners, managed service providers, resellers, hyperscalers, and technology partners—each with distinct GTM requirements and commercial models.

Partner-Led Demand Engine
Design and execute partner-led demand generation strategy for APAC. Marketing Development Funds (MDF) Program

You'll enable the APAC partner marketing managers and work with the Global MDF program team to drive partner participation, approve and audit co-marketing campaigns, and measure ROI against partner pipeline contribution. Strong partners will see MDF as an investment vehicle for growth, not a compliance requirement.
We're investing heavily in partner channels as the primary engine for customer acquisition and success. Partner-led demand is growing 139% year-over-year, and APAC is our highest-growth region. You'll have real budget, real responsibility, and a platform to shape how ServiceNow scales through partners globally.

Experience
10+ years in partner marketing, channel marketing, or go-to-market strategy at B2B SaaS or enterprise software companies. About Anthropic
Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. This is a partner marketing role that demands product marketing craft. You'll be the single-threaded owner of how every Claude launch lands on partner marketing surfaces. We reach many of our most important customers through our partners.

When we ship a new model or capability, it doesn't just launch on first-party surfaces; it launches across our growing partner ecosystem, each with their own product pages, blogs, seller enablement, and go-to-market motions. Our product release cadence has accelerated, and we're looking for someone to own that translation end-to-end.
Model and capabilities launches are the core of the job and the majority of the work. The rest is solution launches — the joint and co-built solutions that land on partner surfaces alongside our models. The two halves reinforce each other. Model launches create the moment; solution launches translate what’s possible for the sellers and customers on the other side.
You'll be the first dedicated owner of launch readiness across our partner surfaces, consolidating work currently spread across several people and creating a center of excellence for how we do this work.

This role centralizes launch coordination for our partners — briefing partner teams under confidentiality, shaping how our positioning shows up on their surfaces, and orchestrating execution cross functionally. You'll be the person who knows exactly what's available on which surface, how we're messaging it, and how it all fits together.

You will use this knowledge to ensure our launches are positioned for the highest impact and amplification across our partners.
The job is roughly half launch execution and half building. On the execution side, you'll run the launch playbook. On the building side, you'll define what we haven't had the bandwidth to create yet. You'll set the standard for how Anthropic shows up on partner surfaces and hold the rest of the company to it, without anyone involved reporting to you.
Anthropic reaches a substantial share of its customer base through partner surfaces, and the ecosystem is still growing. How Claude shows up on the platforms where enterprises actually buy AI is largely unwritten. This is the role that writes it.

Privacy Statement
All member records are protected according to ourPrivacy Policy. Further, while employees of Headspace (formerly Ginger) cannot access Headspace products/services, they will be offered benefits according to the company's benefit plan.

To ensure we are adhering to best practice and ethical guidelines in the field of mental health, we take care to avoid dual relationships.

A dual relationship occurs when a mental health care provider has a second, significantly different relationship with their client in addition to the traditional client-therapist relationship—including, for example, a managerial relationship.
As such, Headspace requests that individuals who have received coaching or clinical services at Headspace wait until their care with Headspace is complete before applying for a position. If someone with a Headspace account is hired for a position, please note their account will be deactivated and they will not be able to use Headspace services for the duration of their employment.
Further, if Headspace cannot find a role that fails to resolve an ethical issue associated with a dual relationship, Headspace may need to take steps to ensure ethical obligations are being adhered to, including a delayed start date or a potential leave of absence. Such steps would be taken to protect both the former member, as well as any relevant individuals from their care team, from impairment, risk of exploitation, or harm.

They need a long-term growth strategy: a clear view of which accounts deserve disproportionate investment, what will materially change their value, and how Fresh Prints should serve, retain, and expand them over time. Your job will be to build that strategy.
You will bring together customer insights, data, segmentation, and operational execution to determine where the biggest account growth opportunities exist and what the business must do to capture them. The goal is to build an account-growth system that becomes more intelligent, more effective, and more valuable with every cycle.
There is no established function to inherit and no finished playbook to manage. You will define what account-based marketing should mean for Fresh Prints, build the operating model behind it, and drive the business to execute against it across Marketing, Sales, Creative, Data, and Operations.
We are not looking for someone who will optimize the existing approach at the margins. We are looking for someone who will question its assumptions, identify the few bets that could materially change account value, and take responsibility for turning those bets into results.

Defining how Fresh Prints grows and retains its most valuable accounts at the company level, not simply running better campaigns.
Building an account strategy that continues to work as chapters, decision-makers, relationships, and buying cycles change.
Identifying the few highest-leverage bets that could materially increase account value, then focusing the business around them.

As we create a colorful, capable and cleaner world through chemistry, we invite you to join our team to harness the power of chemistry to shape markets, redefine industries and improve lives for billions of people around the world.
Creating essential chemistry that the world needs
At Chemours, our people are redefining how the world thinks of chemistry by approaching everything we do with a commitment to delivering Trusted Chemistry that creates better lives and helps communities thrive. That begins with how we use our science, data, and technical expertise to develop market-leading products with high levels of performance, sustainability and safety.
Powered by chemistry, our products are used in applications that make the products we rely on, processes and new technologies possible. In key sectors such as clean energy, advanced electronics, high-performance computing and AI, climate-friendly cooling, and high-quality paints and coatings for homes and industrial infrastructure, sustainable solutions and more modern living depend on Chemours chemistry.
Chemours is seeking a Technical Marketing Specialist TSS to join our growing Thermal & Specialized Solutions team. This position is remote based in Germany and reports directly to the Regional Technical Manager EMEA. The role primarily supports customers and projects across the DACH region, the Netherlands and the Nordics, while also contributing to broader European initiatives.

The refrigeration and HVAC industry is undergoing one of its biggest transitions in decades. Regulations are evolving, refrigerants are changing, and manufacturers are continuously evaluating how to improve environmental performance without compromising safety, efficiency or reliability.
As Technical Marketing Specialist, you will help customers navigate that transition.
Working at the intersection of engineering, application development, business development and technical marketing, you will collaborate with OEMs, consultants, end-users, retailers, universities and industry organizations across Europe to support the qualification and adoption of next-generation refrigerants. Through technical projects, market intelligence and customer engagement, you will help translate industry challenges into practical solutions and business opportunities.
This is not a traditional marketing role. It is a highly visible technical position where you will influence customers, support industry initiatives and help shape the future of sustainable cooling technologies.
The responsibilities of the position include, but are not limited to, the following:
Lead application development projects within refrigeration, air-conditioning and heat pump markets.
Support OEMs and customers with the qualification and implementation of next-generation refrigerants.
Serve as a technical expert and trusted advisor for customers and industry stakeholders.
Identify and develop technical projects that support business growth and market adoption.
Analyze field trial and application data and provide recommendations to internal and external stakeholders.
Develop technical papers, case studies and conference presentations.
Monitor market developments, customer needs and competitive activity to support business strategy.
Support codes, standards and regulatory activities across Europe.
Build relationships with universities, industry associations and standardization committees.
Collaborate closely with Technical Marketing, Business Development, Product Management, Sales, Regulatory and R&D teams globally.

Bachelor’s or master’s degree in mechanical engineering, Chemical Engineering or a related technical discipline.
Several years of experience within refrigeration, HVAC, heat pumps or related thermal systems industries.

Experience working with refrigerants, refrigeration systems, HVAC technologies or heat pumps.
Experience engaging with customers, OEMs, consultants or other external industry stakeholders.
Strong analytical and project management capabilities.
Strong communication and presentation skills.
Fluency in German and English.
Ability to independently manage projects and operate effectively in a matrix environment.

Execution in HubSpot: Own our HubSpot instance end to end, build and launch campaigns, emails, workflows, and lifecycle steps, and maintain the architecture as our MOPs owner
Distribution loop: Take what our content team writes & publishes, test formats and channels, read performance, and scale what works
Measurement: Own program KPIs and marketing reporting. Keep a defensible view of what's working that informs what we build next
Applied AI: use AI to accelerate program production, enablement, and case study work without flattening our voice

We are seeking a Senior Field Marketing Manager to lead enterprise-focused strategy and demand orchestration for our EMEA Sales organisation. In this role, you are a strategic partner to sales leadership and a key architect of Smartsheet’s field marketing engine. You are accountable for driving pipeline velocity, defining investment strategy, and establishing the operational rigor required to win in complex enterprise accounts.
This is a role for a seasoned field marketing leader who thrives in evolving environments. You will look beyond individual tactics to build scalable marketing engagement plans that can be leveraged across the organization, ensuring Smartsheet maintains a world-class presence that resonates with sophisticated buying committees and drives measurable revenue impact.

Drive Segment Pipeline & Engagement: Achieve account and segment pipeline and engagement goals through targeted marketing strategies and tactics tailored to the high-priority sales segment you support.
Own Segment Strategy: Align marketing investment directly to enterprise revenue targets, pipeline gaps, and regional sales priorities for your segment.
Deliver Regional Event Excellence: Align and collaborate with other marketing teams such as Customer marketing, Demand events, Growth marketing, Sales development and others to create and deliver regional events and programs that meet regional pipeline, awareness, and customer cross-sell and upsell objectives.
Orchestrate Sales Alignment: Establish and lead regular bi-directional pipeline inspection cadences with Sales leadership to identify coverage gaps, track conversion, and course-correct investments in real-time.
Develop Scalable Playbooks: Create and pilot multi-dimensional program templates, such as executive roundtables, bespoke customer days, and summits, that can be scaled as "playbooks" for the broader global team.
Master Full-Funnel Accountability: Partner cross-functionally with Global Campaigns, Product Marketing, and SDRs to ensure the field has the messaging and enablement needed to accelerate deals at every stage.
Maintain Operational Rigor: Manage complex regional budgets with precision and maintain high standards of data integrity within Salesforce and Tableau, ensuring all activities are tied to measurable ROI.
Ignite a Culture of Inclusivity: Foster an environment that recognizes the diverse strengths individuals bring to the team to promote engagement and innovative marketing strategies.

What Success Looks Like
Strategic Partnership: You are recognized as a key advisor to Sales leadership, influencing territory planning and resource allocation through data-backed marketing insights.
Pipeline Acceleration: You successfully drive measurable increases in pipeline velocity and deal size through targeted marketing interventions.
Operational Mastery: You maintain flawless operational rigor, with 100% accuracy in budget management and lead-flow tracking.
Playbook Innovation: You have successfully created at least one repeatable marketing "play" or process improvement adopted by the wider field marketing organization.
You Have
7–10+ years of B2B marketing experience , specifically in Field Marketing, Demand Generation, or Integrated Marketing with an enterprise focus.
Proven Track Record: Demonstrated success driving pipeline creation, acceleration, and revenue impact in high-growth environments.
Enterprise Expertise: Deep understanding of executive-level engagement and tailoring messaging for complex buying committees and large-scale deals.
Data-Driven Mindset: Significant experience using Salesforce and Tableau to analyze pipeline health and provide executive reporting.
Builder Mentality: Exceptional ability to navigate ambiguity, lead cross-functional teams, and build processes from the ground up.

We're looking for our founding APAC Field Marketing Leader, someone strategy-strong who can autonomously own a regional function end to end — set the strategy, build the operating system, carry the number, and represent marketing credibly to regional sales leadership and to global marketing leadership at the same time. Not a program manager who executes a plan set elsewhere.
The essential tension to screen for: this person needs the seniority and judgment to lead an org, and the willingness to be a team of one for a while. Regional expansion is planned but the timing isn't fixed, which means for some meaningful period they are writing the doc, running the roundtable, and negotiating with the agency themselves. Scrappy, low-ego, and hands-on — but senior enough to see the whole picture without the support systems a mature regional marketing org would provide.
Regional judgment matters more here than in most field marketing roles. One person cannot serve five sub-regions equally, so the job is fundamentally about sequencing: which markets get real first-party investment, which get partner-led coverage, and which wait. They need to make those calls, defend them to sales leaders in each market, and revisit them as signal comes in.
Partner fluency is not a nice-to-have in this region — it's the primary distribution mechanism. Someone who has only run first-party programs will find the leverage model unfamiliar.
What a successful candidate looks like: a leader who landed in a new region with nothing, picked the right two markets to prove out, used partner and agency capacity to punch well above their headcount, and can point to the pipeline, the operating system, and the team plan they left behind.

The partner-led regional leader. Led co-marketing and demand programs through cloud providers, resellers, and distributors across APAC markets. Strongest on leverage and ecosystem motion. Pressure-test whether they can also build direct enterprise ABM and own a pipeline number independent of partners.
The multi-market APAC field marketing leader. Owned field marketing across several APAC sub-regions at a scaled tech company. Brings market fluency, local vendor and event relationships, and cultural range. Pressure-test appetite for building infrastructure from scratch rather than operating within an existing system, and for the period before they have a team.

Attentive is looking for a Partner Marketing Manager who thinks like a product marketer and operates like a storyteller. This person will own the integration narrative across our technology partner portfolio—crafting the messaging, content, and enablement assets that help partners and customers understand the value of connecting Attentive with the tools they already love.
You’ll sit at the intersection of product, partnerships, and marketing—translating technical integrations into compelling value stories.
This role is perfect for someone looking to progress their career in partner marketing and events with a dynamic and growing company. If you are passionate about creating memorable experiences and supporting a team that drives meaningful results, we would love to hear from you!
What You’ll Accomplish
Support go-to-market messaging and positioning for new technology integrations
Partner closely with Product, Marketing, and Partnerships to build a repeatable launch playbook—from integration announcement through adoption campaigns
Develop differentiated integration narratives that articulate the “better together” story for partners, including Snowflake, Movable Ink, and Shopify, and emerging integrations and continue to improve messaging as integration use cases evolve
Create content that drives integration adoption: solution briefs, landing pages, email campaigns, and partner co-marketing assets.
Partner with cross-functional marketing teams to build partner-driven content
Identify case study opportunities to amplify the value of integrations and collaborate with customer marketing to create case studies
Build strong relationships with the CS and enablement team to ensure teams can speak to integration value, drive adoption, and surface customer feedback
Stay close to the product roadmap to anticipate upcoming integration stories and get ahead of launch needs

4–6 years of experience in product marketing, partner marketing, or content marketing—ideally in B2B SaaS or martech

Willingness to travel

🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.
We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.
After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts , accounts for 16-17 year olds , a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save , invest and combine their pensions with us.
With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!
We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️

About Business Banking at Monzo
Since its launch five years ago, Monzo Business Banking has been dedicated to delivering the very best of Monzo to small businesses. Today, it's an award-winning service, empowering over 1 million businesses across the UK.
As Monzo expands across Europe, Business Banking is entering its next phase: adapting our products and proposition for small businesses in new markets, while continuing our mission to make money work for businesses.

We’re looking for several Senior PMMs to own Product Marketing for entire products and experiences.
A useful distinction - at Monzo, Product Marketing starts upstream in product-market fit. We're embedded in squads with Product Managers, Data Scientists, Designers, User Researchers, and Sales, bringing the voice of the customer and market into what we build, how we position it, and how we take it to market.

We own customer and market understanding, positioning, proposition, launch strategy, and sales enablement. We then partner closely with Integrated Marketing, who lead campaign strategy, creative direction, channel execution, and growth. Together, we build the right products and help them succeed in market.
This is a senior individual contributor role. You'll own Product Marketing for a product end-to-end: understanding customers, shaping product strategy, defining positioning, and helping bring launches to market.
Where you could join
Business Banking EU. Business Banking is entering its next phase of growth as we expand beyond the UK.

In this role, you'll define how Monzo Business Banking succeeds in new European markets - understanding local customer needs, building the proposition that translates our core product into local relevance, and working across Product, Growth, Marketing, and local teams to bring those products to market.

This is a senior role for someone with high autonomy who loves turning dense customer and market insight into practical decisions about what should launch.
Business Banking . Business Banking is growing quickly, serving more than one million businesses across the UK while expanding into increasingly sophisticated customer needs.

In this role, you'll shape how our products are positioned, sold, and adopted—from defining compelling product narratives to enabling Sales and partnering with Growth and Marketing on launches.

This is a role for someone who enjoys sitting at the intersection of Product and commercial teams, translating customer insight into positioning, propositions, and go-to-market strategies that help more businesses choose Monzo.

Set Product Marketing Strategy for a set of products. You'll define a one-year Product Marketing strategy for a major area of Business Banking, connecting customer insight, market opportunity, and commercial priorities into a clear direction for the product area, rather than one individual product, with measurable business outcomes.
Develop differentiated positioning & messaging: You'll create compelling positioning, messaging, and value propositions that differentiate Monzo in the market and resonate with different customer segments. You'll build messaging frameworks that Product, Sales, Integrated Marketing, and broader marketing teams use consistently across launches and customer journeys.
Drive competitive intelligence and market insights : You’ll build and maintain the market view for your product area. You'll become the recognised authority on your customer segment and competitive landscape, building a coherent view of the market from customer research, commercial data, competitor intelligence, and Sales insight. Your recommendations will shape product strategy, positioning, go-to-market, and commercial priorities across the Business Banking collective.
Shape product strategy across markets. You'll partner closely with Product, Research, Design, and Data to identify customer problems, market opportunities, and competitive gaps that influence roadmap priorities. Your customer and market insight will shape what we build, not just how we bring it to market.
Set the go-to-market strategy for priority products and markets . You'll define what audiences we prioritise, why they would choose Monzo, what needs to be true for them to switch and stay, and what success looks like - giving Product, Sales, Marketing, and local market teams a shared strategic direction for how the product enters or scales in market.
Own product representation across the customer journey. You'll define the core proposition and value messages that should carry through key customer and sales touchpoints, so customers consistently understand why the product matters. You'll partner with teams across Product, Sales, Marketing, CRM, and local markets to make sure the customer experience reflects the agreed positioning.
Enable localisation: You'll work with local market teams to determine what should remain globally consistent and what should adapt locally, ensuring positioning, customer journeys, and launches resonate in each market while strengthening the overall Monzo Business Banking proposition.

You're recognised for your Product Marketing expertise. You're comfortable owning Product Marketing across a product area or market, and people seek your perspective on customers, competitors, positioning, and product strategy.
You bring senior stakeholders with you & thrive in cross-functional environments. You work effectively across Product, Sales, Growth, Marketing, and Research, building alignment around difficult decisions and helping teams make confident product and commercial choices.
You raise the quality of the work around you. You enjoy mentoring less experienced PMMs, sharing your expertise, and improving how the team works through better frameworks, feedback, and knowledge sharing.

Brand Management at Riot is focused on players and fans. Our mission is to make it better to be a player by building trust, inspiring fandom, and creating meaningful, resonant experiences across every touchpoint. For Teamfight Tactics, this means celebrating the strategy, creativity, and playfulness at the heart of the game and bringing these values to life.
As a Brand Manager III for Teamfight Tactics (TFT), you will lead high-impact initiatives and deliver world-class campaigns that strengthen TFT’s brand identity.

You will shape global perception by defining how the game shows up to players, crafting integrated publishing strategies and guiding creative expression across sets, features, and player moments.

This role builds a cohesive, enduring brand, ensuring consistency in tone, voice, and visual identity while partnering closely with cross-functional teams to bring the brand to life.
Reporting to the Senior Manager, Brand Marketing, you will own go-to-market strategy and execution for global player experiences, balancing long-term brand building with moment-based impact. Operating at the intersection of product, publishing, and creative, you will lead campaign development, align partners, manage budgets, and uphold a high bar for craft to deliver culturally resonant, distinctly TFT work.

Brand & Campaign Leadership
Lead the creation of high-quality global campaigns in partnership with creative, production, and community teams
Partner with game development leadership to shape campaign strategy across sets, features, and key moments
Develop integrated, cross-platform campaign plans that express TFT’s gameplay, creativity, and evolving set fantasies
Ensure campaigns reinforce a cohesive brand identity, tone, and player promise
Cross-Functional Collaboration & Global Publishing
Partner with product, communications, social, and community teams to align on campaign narratives, publishing priorities, and evergreen programs
Collaborate with insights to inform strategy and global publishing decisions
Lead and support Regional Brand Leads through campaign cycles, ensuring global alignment and effective local execution
Creative & Operational Excellence
Provide strategic direction to guide creative development with a consistent tone, voice, and narrative
Translate insights into clear creative briefs and campaign strategies
Manage brand marketing budgets and execution, ensuring delivery on time and on budget
Stay connected to players, culture, and the competitive landscape to inform brand direction

6+ years of experience in brand strategy, product marketing, publishing, or equivalent roles
Experience leading integrated go-to-market campaigns from strategy through execution and measurement
Strong understanding of growth and performance marketing, with the ability to connect brand strategy to business outcomes
Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams and influence stakeholders across disciplines and regions
Strong strategic thinking, with experience translating insights into plans, briefs, and campaign direction
Experience working with gaming audiences, ideally within live-service or strategy-driven genres
Excellent communication skills, with experience aligning diverse stakeholders
Strong organizational and project management skills, managing complex timelines and dependencies

Familiarity with TFT, Riot IP, and the strategy or live-service game landscape
Experience working with game development teams and understanding development cycles
Experience with media planning, user acquisition, or channel strategy within full-funnel campaigns
Experience managing campaigns across PC, mobile, and console
Strong awareness of digital culture and player communities
Passion for games across PC, mobile, and/or console
For this role, you'll find success through craft expertise, a collaborative spirit, and decision-making that prioritizes the delight of players. We will be looking at your past studies, experience, and your personal relationship with games. If you embody player empathy and care about players' experiences, this could be your role!

Riot focuses on work/life balance, shown by our open paid time off policy and other perks such as flexible work schedules. We offer medical, dental, and life insurance, parental leave for you, your spouse/domestic partner, and children, and a 401k with company match. Check out our benefits pages for more information.
At Riot Games, we put players first . That mission drives every decision in our quest to create games and experiences that make it better to be a player. Whether you’re working directly on a new player-facing experience or you’re supporting the company as a whole, everyone at Riot is part of our mission.

And just like in our games, we’re better when we work together. Our goal is to create collaborative teams where you are empowered to bring your unique perspective everyday. If that sounds like the kind of place you want to work, we’re looking forward to your application.
